rows.scope: Component curves only; no deployment workload or capacity is declared.

rows.excluded: raw construction and correctness checks
rows.name: acts
rows.recipe: Distinct sequential identities over the same named cell, four alternating Actor names; mixed alternates binary and paired structural fixture families. No graph formation or authentication validity is claimed.
rows.timed: validate_history, including returned owned output destruction

rows.excluded: raw construction, burn and policy binding, correctness, per-iteration input clone
rows.name: markers
rows.recipe: Seed-zero burn fixture; initial empty marker then repeated complete accepted singleton r0 and lineage r0,r1, with distinct sequential predecessor positions. Three retained burn records include one consistent alias. Fixture proof equality is not cryptography or chain finality.
rows.timed: validate_marker_history followed by recognize_markers, including returned owned output destruction

rows.excluded: payload and canonical/chunked encoding construction, correctness
rows.name: bytes
rows.recipe: Payload index modulo payload_modulus; canonical byte string or indefinite string with an initial empty chunk and an empty chunk after each definite chunk. Input limit equals wire length; item limit equals payload length plus four. These are experiment limits, never production defaults.
rows.timed: strict or transport decoding and owned output destruction; transport counters include the decoder's allocations

rows.excluded: constructor chain, admission, independent roundtrip controls and fresh per-iteration numeric context; internal restore contexts remain timed
rows.name: publication
rows.recipe: Seed zero; one registered Actor and one Opinion at the first boundary, then two Opinions at each successor boundary, retaining two complete acts per boundary. A fixed synthetic burn of 1000 supports the declared fixture range. Public candidate, closure, schedule, compiler and publication constructors build every successor. Each boundary has a complete marker history and declared synthetic retained verifier, never cryptographic evidence.
rows.timed: encode, decode, or decode followed by disclosures::restore, including allocations and owned output destruction

rows.excluded: valid package assembly, padding generation, byte/control preparation and per-iteration numeric context
rows.name: publication-bytes
rows.recipe: One admitted boundary; realization provenance is byte index modulo 251, bound by the fixture verifier before assembly. Authentication fields and mathematical causes stay unchanged.
rows.timed: canonical publication encode or decode and owned output destruction

rows.excluded: service start/stop, runtime, secret configuration, connection, schema, population and correctness controls; schema and population walls retained separately
rows.name: storage
rows.recipe: One private PostgreSQL database per size, one Rule key, constructor-validated unsigned payloads and contiguous immutable successors. Repeat setup is idempotent. No other fixture uses these databases.
rows.timed: current-thread runtime block_on of load_boundary or audit_history, including transaction, driver and returned output destruction

rows.excluded: Construction, validation, oracle/counter checks and fresh input/context setup; rejected points have no fitted samples.
rows.name: partition
rows.recipe: Seed zero, constructor-backed B2 recipe in packages/graph/benches/support; complete validated causes; finite synthetic numerical limits, not deployment defaults.
rows.timed: Public component operation and owned output destruction; B6 includes mandatory replay; B7 replays the exact returned B6 record, never an unrelated case.

rows.excluded: Construction, validation, oracle/counter checks and fresh input/context setup; rejected points have no fitted samples.
rows.name: transport
rows.recipe: Seed zero, constructor-backed B4 recipe in packages/graph/benches/support; complete validated causes; finite synthetic numerical limits, not deployment defaults. Construction has its own 140,000,000 Work and 5,000,000 arithmetic-step budget per builder, separate from measured operations. Largest dense N=256 construction measured 14,830,265 Work / 461,377 steps for rational inputs and 65,774,560 Work / 2,055,455 steps for interval conversion; limits are twice the larger counts rounded upward to ten-million Work and million steps. Separate oracle Work 20,000,000,000 and operation Work 2,000,000,000 support the denser grid without coupling the exact operation to the former 2,000,000 enclosed oracle.
rows.timed: Public component operation and owned output destruction; B6 includes mandatory replay; B7 replays the exact returned B6 record, never an unrelated case.
